about: Hand-labelled sentences for the call judges OWN_VIEW and CALL_YOU (the second deep scan of 0.9.8, evals-holdout-and-judges-tuned-on-results): a judge changed after a run must still read every one as labelled. Each item's source says where it came from: 'logged' is a reply the model gave in a run (in-sample: the judge was tuned on it), 'written' is a sentence written for this set (on 29 Oct, or the day it names) and never seen from the model; 'tuning list, 28 Oct' is a sentence of the judge's own test list of 28 Oct (tests/test_eval_call_length.py), written before this set and tuned on (release review of 0.9.8, E07). 'gap' marks a sentence the judge reads wrong today: listed, never hidden; a judge change that reads it right moves it out of the gaps.
